inlines.text: 为 Google Cloud 的 Agents CLI、Agent Garden 和 Gemini Enterprise 应用提供支持的精选 ADK recipes 库。

blocks.text: 引言

如今，在 Google Cloud 上构建应用的开发者可以从终端搭建一个长时程记忆智能体，用一行命令将零售垂直技能安装到编码助手中，并将一个完整接线的生产服务部署到 Cloud Run、Agent Runtime、Agent Garden 或 Gemini Enterprise 应用——所有这些都来自同一个精选源码树。这个源码树就是 google/adk-recipes，它是 google/adk-samples 重构后的继任者，如今从单一事实来源为 Agent Platform 提供服务。

blocks.text: google/adk-recipes 将其内容分为三个顶层文件夹：core/ 用于由 Agents CLI 和 DevRel 团队精选的参考模式，plugins/ 用于以 Plugin Recipes 形式打包、符合 Agent Plugins v1.0.0 规范的可安装垂直技能，contrib/ 用于跨五种语言的端到端可部署服务。每一部分都以机器可读性为首要考虑进行设计。

blocks.text: adk-recipes 是 ADK 内容在三个消费它的 Agent Platform 界面中的单一事实来源。每个界面都通过自己的协议读取该仓库。

blocks.text: Agents CLI 读取 core/。当开发者运行 uvx --from google-agents-cli agents-cli create my-agent 时，Agents CLI 可以按需搭建一个 core/ recipe。该 CLI 于今年早些时候在 Google Cloud Next 上推出，暴露了完整的搭建 → 部署 → 评估 → 发布生命周期；它提供的基础内容来自我们的 recipes。Horizon 是我们下面要考察的参考 harness，就是一个被 Agents CLI 视为生产模板的示例模式。

blocks.text: Agent Garden 提供精选内容。面向开发者的进入该仓库的路径是向 contrib/ 提交拉取请求：一个 recipe 进入 GitHub，成为公共 ADK 生态系统的一部分，从那一刻起就可被其他开发者和读取该仓库的编码助手发现。出现在 Agent Garden 图库中则是 Agent Garden 团队做出的另一项编辑决定，该团队会精选一部分 recipes，并按自己的节奏将其推广到公共目录。一旦某个智能体进入图库，Google Cloud 项目中的任何开发者都可以一键安装。

blocks.text: 除了这些主要界面之外，Google Cloud 自身的基础设施组件也作为构建模块出现在这些配方之中。Horizon 使用 Agent Platform Sandboxes 实现按用户隔离的沙箱环境，使用 Memory Bank 实现持久记忆，并使用 Agent Platform Sessions 管理会话状态。零售产品搜索 Plugin Recipe 在 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上使用 Vector Search 2.0，并与 BigQuery 搭配。零售虚拟试穿 Plugin Recipe 使用 Gemini 图像模型生成静态合成图，并使用 Veo 3.1 Reference-to-Video 生成动画输出。这些配方并非只是与 Agent Platform 并存；它们记录了 Agent Platform 的实际使用方式。

blocks.text: Horizon：一个参考模式，用于 core/

构建一个能够处理单次对话的智能体是一个已被充分理解的问题。构建一个能够在多天的交互中保持自身状态、记住用户昨天做了什么并规划明天任务的智能体，则是一项本质上不同的工作。这类长时程系统的难点，无论智能体被构建来做什么，都是相同的：跨会话记忆、工具执行的按用户沙箱隔离、密钥管理、防止失控行为的护栏，以及使多步骤任务可恢复的编排原语。Horizon 位于 core/python/long-horizon-harness，是我们构建的参考测试框架，用于将这些原语汇集在一处。

这个插件目前提供两项技能。第一项，retail-product-search，构建一个 ADK 智能体，配备一个由 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上的 Vector Search 2.0 和 BigQuery 目录支持的向量搜索检索工具。该技能处理整个流程：将 CSV 或 JSON 目录导入 BigQuery，使用 Vertex AI Embeddings 生成多模态和文本嵌入，构建 Vector Search 集合，用 retrieve_docs 工具搭建 ADK 智能体脚手架，并部署到 Cloud Run。该智能体刻意设计为单智能体：一个 root_agent 配一个检索工具，没有协调层。语义复杂性存在于检索流程和评估标准中，而非智能体之间的通信；添加编排层会掩盖这一模式，而不是阐明它。

blocks.text: Introduction

A developer building on Google Cloud today can scaffold a long-horizon memory agent from the terminal, install a retail vertical skill into a coding assistant with one line, and deploy a fully-wired production service to Cloud Run, Agent Runtime, Agent Garden, or Gemini Enterprise app — all from the same curated source tree. That tree is google/adk-recipes, the restructured successor to google/adk-samples that now serves Agent Platform from a single source of truth.

blocks.text: Horizon: a reference pattern for core/

Building an agent that can handle a single conversation is a well-understood problem. Building one that holds its own across days of interaction, remembering what the user did yesterday and planning tasks for tomorrow, is a materially different undertaking. The hard parts of such a long-horizon system are the same regardless of what the agent is being built to do: cross-session memory, per-user sandboxing of tool execution, secrets management, guardrails against runaway behaviour, and the orchestration primitives that make multi-step tasks resumable. Horizon, which lives at core/python/long-horizon-harness, is the reference harness we built to collect these primitives in one place.

blocks.text: The Plugin Recipe format sits on top of the Agent Plugins v1.0.0 specification published at agent-plugins.org, an open standard for packaging installable AI skills across coding assistants. The specification defines a plugin as a bundle of one or more skills with a top-level plugin.json manifest declaring name, version, license, and ownership. Each skill is a self-contained folder with a SKILL.md conversational installer, a README.md, an EVAL.yaml of quality gates, and the scripts and assets the skill needs to do its work. Two skills ship in this plugin today. The first, retail-product-search, builds an ADK agent with a vector-search retrieval tool backed by Vector Search 2.0 on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and a BigQuery catalog. The skill handles the entire pipeline: ingesting a CSV or JSON catalog into BigQuery, generating multimodal and text embeddings with Vertex AI Embeddings, building the Vector Search collection, scaffolding the ADK agent with a retrieve_docs tool, and deploying to Cloud Run. The agent is deliberately single-agent: one root_agent with one retrieval tool and no coordinator layer. The semantic complexity sits in the retrieval pipeline and the evaluator rubric, not in agent-to-agent communication; adding orchestration layers would obscure the pattern rather than clarify it.

blocks.text: The second skill, retail-virtual-tryon, generates a photorealistic composite of a model wearing or holding a product, with an optional eight-second studio catwalk video on top. It uses gemini-2.5-flash-image by default, falling back to gemini-2.5-pro-image when editorial quality matters more than latency. For video it uses veo-3.1-generate-001 in Reference-to-Video mode, conditioning the generated motion on the still produced by the image pipeline. The skill ships a pre-flight product-cutout classifier and configurable safety levels, operational details that become obvious after the third real production deployment.

The skill ecosystem is designed to compose. The retail-product-search SKILL.md instructs the host coding assistant to pull two companion skills from google/skills if they are not already installed, keeping cross-cutting concerns like BigQuery basics and Gemini API usage in one place and reusable by multiple vertical plugins.

blocks.text: Once installed, the coding assistant reads SKILL.md and initiates a Q-MODE interview. For retail-product-search, Quick Start is two questions (GCP project ID and the path to product data, with sensible defaults for both); Full Setup adds two more covering product-fields level and GCP region. By the end of the interview the skill has written a ./design-spec.md reflecting the project's actual shape and executed scripts/setup.py to land the catalog in BigQuery, generate the embeddings, build the Vector Search collection, and run EVAL.yaml against the result. If the rubric and assertion checks fall below the 80 percent passing target, the skill halts and surfaces the specific failures.

blocks.text: The contrib/ layer is where ADK recipes become end-to-end deployable services. Twelve Python agents live there today, spanning the kinds of applications ADK is typically used to build in practice: finance (financial advisor, small-business loan processor), evaluation (LLM auditor), document and knowledge pipelines (high-volume document analyzer, multiformat hybrid RAG), content and brand (brand-aligned presentations, brand-search optimization, on-brand genmedia), retail (product search, virtual try-on), and framework examples (agent-skills tutorial, staged UI widgets). Java, Go, TypeScript, and Kotlin each carry smaller sets. Every entry in contrib/ is a worked example of how a core/ pattern or a plugins/ skill becomes a running service.

blocks.text: To make the relationship between a plugin and its deployable counterpart concrete, take contrib/python/retail-product-search as the example. The retail plugin from the previous section walked a developer through a conversational install that provisioned the Vector Search collection, the BigQuery catalog, and the embeddings. The contrib agent is the deployable counterpart: a long-running service that reads from that collection and answers natural-language shopping queries over it. The plugin owns the one-shot setup; the contrib agent owns the service shape. Both are maintained by the same team to stay synchronised, and the agent's README directs new users to run the plugin's setup first:

blocks.text: Why this matters

A reference harness without a vertical is a toy; a vertical skill without a deployable artifact is a slide; a deployable agent without a reference pattern is a prototype no one can repeat. Shipping all three in one repository, under a shared manifest schema and governance pipeline, lets a developer or a coding assistant walk the stack in either direction, with every Agent Platform surface reading from the same source of truth.

blocks.text: The practical result is a lower barrier from "I need an agent that does X" to a running production service: a coding assistant can scaffold a Horizon-shaped agent, install a vertical Plugin Recipe, and reach the deployment transcripts in contrib/ without translating between repositories or reconciling manifest formats. For teams building vertical solutions, Plugin Recipes package domain expertise once and distribute it to every coding assistant on the market with the same install flow and quality gates.

# Install Agents CLI
uvx --from google-agents-cli agents-cli setup

# Scaffold a Horizon-shaped agent
uvx --from google-agents-cli agents-cli create my-agent

# Install a retail skill into your coding assistant
npx skills add google/adk-recipes --skill retail-product-search --full-depth

# Launch the deployable retail agent as a managed artifact
uvx --from google-agents-cli agents-cli create retail-product-search
